description: This file defines the Variance class, which computes statistical variance for a dataset. It includes methods for incremental and complete evaluation of variance, supports bias correction, and is part of the org.apache.commons.math3.stat.descriptive.moment package.

classes.name: Variance
classes.description: A class for computing the variance of a dataset, supporting incremental updates and full array evaluation, with options for bias correction.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new data point to the variance computation, updating internal state.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the computed variance, considering bias correction.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the number of data points processed.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the Variance object.

methods.name: evaluate (double[])
methods.description: Computes the variance of the given array of values.

methods.name: evaluate (double[], int, int)
methods.description: Computes the variance of a subarray of the input array.

methods.name: evaluate (double[], double[])
methods.description: Computes the weighted variance of the array with given weights.

methods.name: evaluate (double[], double[], int, int)
methods.description: Computes the weighted variance of a subarray with weights and precomputed mean.

methods.name: evaluate (double[], double)
methods.description: Computes the variance using a precomputed mean value.

methods.name: evaluate (double[], double, int, int)
methods.description: Computes the variance of a subarray using a precomputed mean.

methods.name: evaluate (double[], double[], double)
methods.description: Computes the weighted variance with a precomputed weighted mean.

methods.name: evaluate (double[], double[], double, int, int)
methods.description: Computes the weighted variance of a subarray with a precomputed weighted mean.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Variance object.

methods.name: copy (static)
methods.description: Copies source Variance to destination Variance object.
